description: A structured learning plan to take you from Python basics through algorithms and real-world projects.

nodes.title: Python Fundamentals
nodes.description: Learn variables, data types, control flow, functions, and basic I/O. Build a foundation for everything that follows.

nodes.title: Data Structures
nodes.description: Explore lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples. Understand mutability, performance trade-offs, and when to use each.

nodes.title: Algorithms & Complexity
nodes.description: Study sorting, searching, recursion, and Big-O notation to write performant Python programs.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming
nodes.description: Master classes, inheritance, encapsulation, and polymorphism. Apply OOP principles to model real-world problems.

nodes.title: File I/O & Modules
nodes.description: Read and write files, work with the standard library, and structure code into reusable modules and packages.

nodes.title: Error Handling & Testing
nodes.description: Write robust programs with try/except, custom exceptions, and unit tests using pytest.

resources.title: Write Tests for Your Library System

nodes.title: Capstone: CLI Tool
nodes.description: Combine everything you've learned to build a polished command-line application of your choice.

nodes.title: Build a Web Scraper
nodes.description: Skip the theory and start building. Use requests and BeautifulSoup to scrape real websites and store the data.

nodes.title: Async Programming Basics
nodes.description: Learn asyncio and aiohttp to fetch data concurrently. Apply to your scraper to handle many pages at once.

nodes.title: OOP Through Refactoring
nodes.description: Refactor your scraper into a well-structured class hierarchy. Learn OOP by applying it to code you already understand.

nodes.title: Capstone: Full Pipeline
nodes.description: Build a full data pipeline: scrape, process, store to SQLite, and expose via a simple Flask API.
